svg.title: SYN Mirror: a port given at each start, and a fixed port
svg.text: Two ways to a port of meeting

g.text: A port given at each start
2 bytes back, given to the id
sent to it by the server
↻ the next start: another port, another line

svg.text: a minute after the server stops, the port is given to others

g.text: the port is set aside for the key
↻ the next start: the same port, the same line

svg.text: nobody else gets it, ever; closed while the server does not knock
Both: the server dials the port every second, the client dials it once - the meeting is the same
